data.body: Lane f041, 2026-10-20: plan review BLOCK at ca042ec0f49 (2 findings), both valid, both fixed in the plan. (1) The scan's blanket `(?<!from )` lookbehind, meant to skip `from rebar import`, also hid the prose "Import tickets from rebar export NDJSON" at src/rebar/_lib_reads.py:110. The same lookbehind in story cubistic-patrician-deer's rewrite and AC grep is why that docstring survived. The plan now exempts only key `import` preceded by `from `, pins that prose case in a pattern test, and fixes the docstring. (2) The replacement-is-live check looked only at the first word, so `rebar bridge status/fsck/check-access/setup` went unverified past `bridge`. It now also requires the sub-verb to be one of the nested parser's subcommand choices (bridge and store). Dry run in a throwaway worktree at ca042ec0f49: with all edits, 38 passed; with only the docstring reverted, the scan fails naming src/rebar/_lib_reads.py:[110].
